long.title: The Fall of Constantinople 1453: The 53-Day Siege That Ended an Empire
long.description:
On the twenty-ninth of May, fourteen fifty-three, a thousand-year empire fell in a single morning. This is the dramatic story of the fifty-three-day siege of Constantinople: Sultan Mehmed the Second's monstrous cannons, the impossible feat of warships dragged across hills, and Emperor Constantine the Eleventh's heroic last stand behind the mighty Theodosian Walls.

CHAPTERS:
0:00 The City of Emperors
1:17 An Empire in Twilight
2:32 The Young Sultan
3:52 The Siege Begins
5:11 Ships Across the Hills
6:20 The Final Night
7:28 The City Falls
8:43 Echoes of History

If you love epic stories from world history, subscribe to Echoes of History Channel for a new documentary every day.
